macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

items.title: U.S. Treasury to double long-dated bond buybacks, easing pressure on yields
items.summary: The Treasury Department said it will increase liquidity support by doubling buyback operations for long-dated nominal coupon securities to at least $4 billion per operation, helping pull longer-dated yields down from multi-decade highs. The move lifted stocks and bonds while weighing on the dollar.

items.title: U.S. dollar weakens as Treasury yields retreat and markets await Fed minutes
items.summary: The dollar drifted near multi-month lows after Treasury yields eased from recent highs, with the dollar index slipping to around 99.65. Investors were also waiting for the Federal Reserve’s latest meeting minutes for clues on the rate path.

items.title: Wall Street rebounds as yields fall; Moderna surges on oncology deal
items.summary: U.S. equities recovered from Tuesday’s tech-led slump, with the S&P 500, Dow, and Nasdaq all higher after the Treasury’s buyback announcement pulled yields lower. Moderna jumped sharply after announcing a cancer-testing related deal, helping lift healthcare shares.

items.title: U.S. bond-market selloff remains a global policy concern
items.summary: Global bond yields had recently surged on worries about inflation, deficits, and heavy government borrowing, forcing policymakers to confront higher financing costs. Recent Treasury intervention helped stabilize markets, but the episode highlighted ongoing stress in sovereign debt markets.

items.title: Indian markets fall as higher crude prices and global risk-off sentiment hit equities
items.summary: Sensex and Nifty extended losses, with higher crude prices and geopolitical uncertainty weighing on investor sentiment. Broader Asian markets were also softer after the U.S. tech selloff and elevated Treasury yields.

items.title: SEBI bans two entities over Sensex closing-auction manipulation
items.summary: India’s market regulator barred two entities for allegedly manipulating the Sensex during a closing auction and froze ₹3.68 crore. The action was framed as a market-integrity enforcement step.

items.title: Swiss franc firm, dollar softens ahead of Fed minutes
items.summary: Markets were cautious ahead of the Fed minutes, with the dollar softening against major peers and the Swiss franc holding firm. The report points to a broader wait-and-see stance across central-bank markets.

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: Bitcoin jumps above $68,000 as Treasury buyback plan sparks risk-asset rally
items.summary: Bitcoin surged more than 5% in 24 hours and briefly traded above $69,000 after the U.S. Treasury said it would at least double longer-term bond buybacks, a move that lifted risk assets broadly. Ethereum rose about 9% and Solana gained roughly 5.5% in the same move.

items.title: Over $1 billion in Bitcoin shorts liquidated in hours
items.summary: Bitcoin’s rally triggered a major short squeeze, with more than $1 billion in BTC short positions wiped out in four hours and over $1.7 billion liquidated across 24 hours, according to market data cited by Bitcoin Magazine. The move came alongside expectations of friendlier crypto policy developments in Washington.

items.title: Crypto market broadly higher; Bitcoin tops $68,000 and volume surges
items.summary: Major digital assets moved higher, with Bitcoin up about 5.8% to roughly $68,385 and Ethereum up 9.7% near $2,098. The total crypto market value rose to about $2.32 trillion as trading volume increased sharply.

items.title: Bitcoin reaches highest level since June after Treasury debt buyback announcement
items.summary: Bitcoin climbed above $69,000, its strongest level since early June, after the U.S. Treasury said it would double planned buybacks of longer-term government debt. Ether and other major tokens also rose on the back of the liquidity-driven move.

items.title: Trump urges Congress to pass clearer crypto rules at White House meeting
items.summary: At a White House event with crypto executives, President Donald Trump called on Congress to pass a bill that would provide clearer definitions for the cryptocurrency sector. The meeting signaled renewed regulatory focus on the industry.

items.title: SEC reportedly advances first major crypto rule proposal
items.summary: A report cited a surprise SEC announcement of its first major rule proposal for crypto, aimed at allowing certain token offerings without triggering securities obligations. The same report said Maya Protocol halted its network after a vulnerability that caused about $11 million in losses.

items.title: White House crypto meeting boosts crypto stocks and Bitcoin
items.summary: Bitcoin rose roughly 6% to about $68,406, while shares of crypto-related companies also advanced after a White House meeting between President Trump and prominent digital-currency figures. The move marked Bitcoin’s biggest percentage gain since March.

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

items.title: Sony reportedly reworking live-service Horizon spinoff
items.summary: Bloomberg-reported feedback issues have reportedly led Guerrilla Games to reboot Horizon Hunters Gathering into a smaller, more traditional co-op experience. The project was announced earlier this year, but its direction appears to be shifting after negative test reactions.

items.title: GTA 6 leaks intensify ahead of upcoming reveal
items.summary: Multiple outlets report fresh Grand Theft Auto VI gameplay clips and map images surfacing online, with some coverage saying Rockstar has been taking down leaked footage. The leaks come just days before the planned 'Extended Look' reveal.

items.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 reportedly due in October and coming to Switch 2
items.summary: The Verge reports that Modern Warfare 4 is set for an October release on PS5, Xbox Series X/S, PC, and Nintendo's Switch 2. The game is also said to include shader preloading and fewer restarts during play.

items.title: Super Mario Sunshine joins Nintendo Switch Online’s GameCube library
items.summary: Nintendo’s GameCube catalog on Switch Online is expanding, with Super Mario Sunshine among the additions highlighted in recent coverage. The move continues Nintendo’s rollout of classic GameCube titles for Switch 2 users.

items.title: Nintendo’s next Fire Emblem gets a release date
items.summary: Nintendo and The Verge report that Fortune's Weave, the next Fire Emblem game, launches on September 17. The game is described as featuring a new structure for the series.

items.title: Netflix shuts down two game studios
items.summary: Netflix is closing two game studios, including Night School Studio despite the critical praise for Unhinged. The move marks another notable contraction in Netflix’s gaming efforts.

items.title: Konami’s Apple Arcade Castlevania game is shutting down
items.summary: Castlevania: Grimoire of Souls will be removed from download on August 20 and fully shut down on September 3. The mobile/Apple Arcade title launched in 2021 and is now set to end service.

items.title: Xbox Insiders gain more control over local game saves
items.summary: Microsoft is rolling out a testing feature that lets Xbox Insiders view, sort, and delete local saves not currently in use. The update is aimed at giving players more storage-management control.

items.title: Nvidia GeForce Now expands to Firefox and Fire TV
items.summary: Nvidia’s cloud-gaming service can now stream more than 5,000 PC games in Firefox, and an official GeForce Now app has also arrived on Amazon Fire TV. The expansion broadens access across browsers and streaming devices.

items.title: Sonic is coming to Fortnite
items.summary: Epic’s new gaming-themed Fortnite season, Override, is bringing Sonic content into the game. The crossover is part of Fortnite’s ongoing push for major brand and game collaborations.

items.title: Roblox faces Texas lawsuit over child safety concerns
items.summary: Texas has sued Roblox, alleging the platform failed to protect children. The case adds fresh regulatory pressure on the company, which says it has more than 111 million daily active users.

items.title: Xbox Game Pass adds 10 new games for late August and September
items.summary: PCMag reports that Microsoft has announced the next wave of Game Pass titles for late August and September. The lineup gives subscribers a fresh batch of games heading into the fall.

items.title: FPS Games Show debut set for September 3
items.summary: Bulkhead is launching a new FPS-focused showcase on Twitch, with its first broadcast scheduled for September 3. The event will feature first-person-shooter announcements and updates.
